entries.description_source_en: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.
entries.fact_source_en: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.

entries.description_source_en: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
entries.fact_source_en: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
entries.fact_source_en: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

entries.description_source_en: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
entries.fact_source_en: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

entries.description_source_en: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
entries.fact_source_en: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for “moving forests.”

entries.description_source_en: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
entries.fact_source_en: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

entries.description_source_en: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
entries.fact_source_en: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.

entries.description_source_en: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
entries.fact_source_en: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

entries.description_source_en: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
entries.fact_source_en: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

entries.description_source_en: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
entries.fact_source_en: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

entries.description_source_en: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
entries.fact_source_en: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

entries.description_source_en: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.
entries.fact_source_en: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

entries.description_source_en: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.
entries.fact_source_en: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.

entries.description_source_en: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.
entries.fact_source_en: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

entries.description_source_en: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.
entries.fact_source_en: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.

entries.description_source_en: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.
entries.fact_source_en: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

entries.description_source_en: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
entries.fact_source_en: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

entries.description_source_en: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
entries.fact_source_en: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

entries.description_source_en: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.
entries.fact_source_en: Electricity makes this Pokémon’s fur glow. Shinx sends signals to others of its kind by shaking the tip of its tail while the tail tip is shining brightly.

entries.description_source_en: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.
entries.fact_source_en: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’s electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

entries.description_source_en: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.
entries.fact_source_en: Seeing through solid objects uses up a lot of Luxray’s electricity, so the Pokémon sleeps for long periods of time to store up energy.

entries.description_source_en: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.
entries.fact_source_en: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

entries.description_source_en: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.
entries.fact_source_en: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

entries.description_source_en: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.
entries.fact_source_en: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

entries.description_source_en: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.
entries.fact_source_en: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.
